biggest_cut: I would cut the bookkeeping caveats repeated in almost every lemma, such as statements about which constants are fixed before which parameters, whether exceptional sets depend on the weights or tests, and 'actual masses, no equal reweighting'; these belong once in the Section 15 parameter ledger, not restated in Lemmas 15, 30 and 49, Remark 32, and Propositions 26, 34 and 69.
